description: Set element CFD extra variables. The extra variable can be of any type and is associated with the index i as if stored in an array.

examples.description: Store a value in extra slot 1

notes: FISH access differs by version: element.cfd.extra takes (element, index) on 6.00 but only (element) on 7.00/9.8.
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC3D 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (state grade): 3.25 read back exactly on all three consoles (two-argument FISH form on 6.00, one-argument form on 7.00/9.8).
